description: The entity does not consider the potential for fraud in assessing risks to the achievement of objectives.
applicability: Applies to all entities when fraud risk assessments are not conducted, fraud scenarios are not identified, anti-fraud controls are not evaluated, or fraud prevention is not part of the risk management process.

metadata.detection_notes: Review fraud risk assessment documentation, fraud scenario analysis, anti-fraud control design, whistleblower procedures, and evidence of fraud considerations in risk assessments. Look for absence of fraud risk assessments, lack of fraud-specific controls, or no consideration of fraud in control design.
